editorial.blurb: Todoroki Hibachi and Sushi delivers exceptional Japanese cuisine with a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere, where attentive staff and generously portioned dishes shine.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during late weeknight hours for quick service and open seating, or arrive early to secure a table and enjoy the peaceful ambience before peak dinner rush.

topDishes.note: Exceptional chocolate dessert with smooth exterior, spongey cake, rich chocolate shell, and indulgent filling
